name: Fractals
about: Mandelbrot zoom, Julia sets, Koch, dragon and Hilbert curves

text.formula: z → z² + c: does it run away?
…and tiny copies of the whole set

youtube.title: Fractal zoom: what the Mandelbrot set is 🔥 #shorts
youtube.description:
For each point c, repeat z → z² + c from z = 0. If z stays small, c is in the set (black). Zoom in and the edge never gets simpler, with small copies of the whole set.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts

text.formula: Small c: a round, solid shape
Near the edge: lace and spirals
Too big: it breaks into dust

hook.text: One number shapes a whole fractal

youtube.title: Julia set animation: one number, three worlds 🌀 #shorts
youtube.description:
Same formula z → z² + c, now with c fixed and the start point varying. Small c gives a solid blob, c near the Mandelbrot edge gives lace, larger c breaks it into dust.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts

text.formula: Dragon: fold a paper strip again and again
Hilbert: one line that fills a square

hook.text: Can one rule make infinite detail?

youtube.title: Fractal curves: Koch, dragon and Hilbert in 30 s ❄️🐉 #shorts
youtube.description:
A single replacement rule, repeated, makes a snowflake with an infinitely long edge, the paper-folding dragon, and a line that fills a whole square.
